description: This file is the main entry point for a FastAPI backend API for managing notes. It defines API endpoints for health checks, CRUD operations for notes and tags, pinning notes, and includes application setup such as middleware, lifespan events, and routing.

methods.name: lifespan(app: FastAPI)
methods.description: Manage application lifespan: startup by initializing database, shutdown does nothing.

methods.name: list_notes( query: Optional[str] = Query(None, description='Search text to match in title or content'), tag_ids: Optional[List[int]] = Query(None, description='Filter notes by tag IDs'), pinned_only: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description='Return only pinned notes'), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description='Page number'), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description='Number of notes per page'), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieve a paginated list of notes, optionally filtered by search query, tags, or pinned status.

methods.name: create_note(note: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Create a new note with optional title, content, and tags.

methods.name: get_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieve a specific note by ID.

methods.name: update_note(note_id: int, note: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Update fields of an existing note.

methods.name: toggle_pin_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Toggle the pinned status of a note.

methods.name: create_tag(tag: TagCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Create a new tag or return existing if name conflicts.

methods.name: delete_tag(tag_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Delete a tag and disassociate it from all notes.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify API health.

ctags.name: list_notes
ctags.signature: ( query: Optional[str] = Query(None, description='Search text to match in title or content'), tag_ids: Optional[List[int]] = Query(None, description='Filter notes by tag IDs'), pinned_only: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description='Return only pinned notes'), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description='Page number'), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description='Number of notes per page'), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^def update_note(note_id: int, note: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/
ctags.signature: (note_id: int, note: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
